title: VertLncRNAchecker neural network finds positional ancestors of human heart lncRNAs
summary: By integrating mouse cardiac knockout phenotypes with human single-cell data, the authors found 109 cardiomyocyte-indispensable genes whose flanking regions keep conserved position and orientation across vertebrates. VertLncRNAchecker, a neural network web interface, predicts lncRNA-like genes in these regions, termed positional ancestors. In situ experiments detected mature lncRNA transcripts from these loci in mouse, pig and frog hearts. Preprint; the abstract does not give how many predictions were tested.
ai_technology: VertLncRNAchecker neural network predicting lncRNA-like genes
